title: Marsriva MR-US6K Energy Efficient 6kVA Online UPS

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Marsriva MR-US6K Energy Efficient 6kVA Online UPS is a high-performance double-conversion UPS designed for mission-critical environments that require uninterrupted, stable, and clean power.

With its advanced DSP-controlled architecture, this 6kVA UPS delivers true online protection with pure sine wave output, ensuring maximum reliability for servers, data centers, network systems, medical equipment, telecom infrastructure, and industrial applications. Thanks to its 0ms transfer time and wide input voltage tolerance, the MR-US6K is ideal for areas experiencing frequent voltage instability, providing rock-solid protection against surges, drops, spikes, noise, and power outages.

Engineered for heavy-duty workloads, the Marsriva MR-US6K supports high power factor output, intelligent battery management, and efficient heat dissipation, extending both battery and system lifespan. Its user-friendly LCD display provides real-time monitoring of input/output voltage, load level, battery health, and system alerts—making operation and maintenance easier than ever. Whether you’re securing a server room, IT infrastructure, or sensitive electronics, the MR-US6K delivers premium performance at an excellent value in Bangladesh.

Key Features


  • 6kVA / High Power Capacity – Ideal for servers, network racks, data centers, medical devices, and industrial equipment
  • True Online Double-Conversion Technology – Ensures full isolation from input power fluctuations
  • Zero Transfer Time (0ms) – Guarantees uninterrupted power during outages
  • Pure Sine Wave Output – Safe for extremely sensitive electronics
  • Wide Input Voltage Range – Designed for Bangladesh’s unstable grid conditions
  • Advanced DSP Control – Improves efficiency, accuracy, and long-term stability
  • High Power Factor Output – Delivers more usable power at reduced losses
  • LCD Monitoring Display – Shows voltage, load, battery status, and warning indicators
  • Intelligent Battery Charging System – Extends battery lifetime and increases backup reliability
  • Strong Protection System – Overload, short-circuit, surge, over-temperature, and battery management protection
  • Heavy-Duty Build Quality – Suitable for professional and industrial environments
